race.comment: GRAFOLOGY (8) first run for the new yard he rounded them up with ease from the rails draw to get his Maiden win out of the way over 1600m at Tamworth. Can keep the momentum going now on the country tracks. BOUJEE GOLD (10) box seated two back to score a solid Maiden win over 1406m at Queanbeyan. Handled the rise in grade with closing third over this trip at Goulburn. Winkers go on and has the ability to overcome the sticky draw. NAVAL OFFICER (2) improved sharply when up to his pet trip with an eye catching second over this course and distance in BM66 grade. Claim helps and shapes as a top three contender. DUNNA RUNNA (6) fitter now second up and ready for the mile and further. Will go back from the draw and can take a hand in the finish.
